NXL.catalyst_title: 10-Year Exclusive South American Distribution & Local Manufacturing Agreement
NXL.what_happened: Nexalin Technology entered into a landmark 10-year exclusive distribution and local manufacturing contract with Inovanexa Medical Technologies covering seven countries (Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Uruguay, Paraguay, Ecuador, and Venezuela). Inovanexa committed to an initial order of 10 Nexalin Sync devices and agreed to fund a local manufacturing plant in Brazil once 30 units are deployed—unlocking royalty streams for Nexalin with zero CapEx. Maxim Group subsequently updated their price target to $15.00.
NXL.chart_breakdown: The stock rocketed from its previous close of $3.50, exploding over 104% in pre-market trade to reach a high of $7.43 on over 14 million shares. Price consistently hugged and held above the 20-period 5m SMA, demonstrating massive buyer demand that absorbed every morning dip.
NXL.float_rotation_risk: Extreme Float Turnover (>2,160%): The 652k tiny public float rotated more than 21 times before the regular opening bell. While low-float squeeze dynamics drive explosive vertical runs, Nexalin is currently working under a Nasdaq listing exception requiring $2.5M in stockholders' equity by January 2027, making an ATM (At-The-Market) offering into strength a significant structural risk.

VEEA.catalyst_title: Commercial Rollout with TROLLEE Across 1,000 Unattended Stores
VEEA.what_happened: Veea announced a major partnership rollout with TROLLEE Holdings Limited to deploy the VeeaONE AI edge computing platform across 1,000 unattended retail stores. This comes on the heels of a $750M merger term sheet with NovaGen Group backed by a $10M cornerstone commitment from GeoNova Capital.
VEEA.chart_breakdown: VEEA surged +36.8% in pre-market, advancing from $2.42 to $3.45 on over 24.8 million shares. The 30x relative volume surge created an aggressive opening liquidity pool, testing multi-week swing highs.
VEEA.float_rotation_risk: Very High Float Turnover (>1,550%): The 1.59M float turned over more than 15 times before the opening bell. Notice that Veea executed a 1-for-20 reverse stock split on August 31, 2026, to meet Nasdaq minimum bid rules, and public warrants (VEEAW) trade alongside the common, posing potential warrant exercise overhang.

MEDS.catalyst_title: Corexa Pharmacy September Revenue Tops $1.0M (+66% vs July) & Product Expansion
MEDS.what_happened: DataMeds AI (formerly Trxade Health) announced preliminary September revenue for its Corexa Pharmacy division exceeding $1.0M, jumping 66% compared to July 2026. The company also announced the commercial launch of its Galectovid DTC product and planned rollout of Long COVID health features across its 6,500-pharmacy network.
MEDS.chart_breakdown: MEDS opened with a +22.7% pre-market gap, pushing through the $3.90 barrier on 18.6 million shares. Volume was over 5x its 10-day benchmark as momentum algorithms and retail traders piled into healthcare turnarounds.
MEDS.float_rotation_risk: High Float Turnover (>1,215%): Trading volume was more than 12x the total available public float (1.53M shares). With ongoing Nasdaq equity requirements and historically high micro-cap offering volatility, afternoon fade risk is high if early momentum stalls.
